def wcols(frame, r0, r1):
    a = frame.ascii.split('\n')

def diff(b, a):

    rows = [r for r in range(64) if ba[r]!=aa[r]]
    cells = sum(ba[r][c]!=aa[r][c] for r in rows for c in range(64))
    return rows, cells
